test_title: PYST 46: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 03 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All stars are rectangles.

All cones are rectangles.

Conclusions:

(I): Some stars are cones.

(II): Some rectangles are cones.

Conclusions:

(I): Some stars are cones.- False (As their is no direct relation between stars and cones , may it is possible but not definite. Hence, it is false.

(II): Some rectangles are cones. - True (All cones are rectangles.Some cones are rectangles and Some rectangles are cones. Hence, it is true.

Only conclusion (II) follows. 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
